implementation: One new test-only module; frozen helper, offline adapter, envelope wrapper and old runners unchanged.

author_development_runs.note: Wrong provenance expectation; production helper unchanged.
Independent rejection paths verified after narrow test repair.

accounting.note: Development and verification reruns are not additional unique tests. Independent checks are not added to 6 test methods. Pure recovery metadata comparisons are not pipeline helper entries.

verified_boundaries: Three paired fixtures preserve exact synthetic request bytes, per-branch original object identity, fingerprints and legacy outcomes.
Missing raw total remains missing in the helper receipt while legacy derived total stays separate.
Empty length envelope returns normally in the wrapper but is not labelled a complete clinical answer or substituted with reasoning.
Invalid finish retains structural evidence before unchanged invalid_provider_response rejection.
An object seen before storage failure can have independently recorded observation true while legacy provider_response_received stays false/transport_failure.
When both structural and failure writes fail, readable files and a later committed terminal do not promote recovered observation from null.
Interrupt after structural persistence preserves that evidence while legacy wrapper returns interrupted with flag false.

Every registered reservation and alternate out is checked through its own fixed rejection reason with zero additional fake/outer calls; source/request/integrity mismatches remain permanently blocking.

repairs.detail: Expected helper provenance corrected to existing derived_prompt_plus_completion.
Benign consumed/alternate-out rejections no longer create a global block that masks other checks; source/request/integrity blocks retained.

observation_limit: Outer wrapper entry is not standalone semantic-parser entry. Wrapper acceptance is not final-answer completeness, clinical accuracy or a review gate.
privacy: Only synthetic fixtures and structural fingerprints; no historical actual responses or individual clinical reviews processed. No answer/reasoning body, reasoning hash, arbitrary exception text/traceback/path copied into synthetic receipts. Content hashes are not anonymization.
limitations: Not a live runtime connection or a production general-purpose adapter.
No expanded observation of Transport pre-return rejects or actual HTTP bytes.
No claim of universal power-loss durability, OS-wide network isolation or authentication against full evidence/code rewrite.
No comparison of HBT02/HBT03 clinical quality, rescue of spent candidates, new model identity check or attribution of NOVA scores.
Runtime timing covers selected module execution or sum of synthetic outer calls only, not whole development/audit/publication.
